integrity: The accompanying finite checker supplements the complete analytic proof; its tests are not an infinite-dimensional certificate. No independent mathematical or priority audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The universal exponent 1/2 is optimal but the numerical prefactor may not be. The result is restricted to scalar-valued complex quadratic polynomials on c0; publication priority remains a best-knowledge assessment.
title: A dimension-free sharp-exponent concentration modulus for complex quadratic polynomials on c-zero
